description_good_justification: README.md opens with the project description: privacy-preserving semantic search and associative memory that runs entirely on the user's machine.
interact_justification: README.md has Installation and Quick Start sections; CONTRIBUTING.md and the issue forms in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ explain how to give feedback and contribute.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Pull Requests' and 'Developer Certificate of Origin' describe the process; .github/pull_request_template.md is the checklist.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Testing Policy' and 'Style Guidelines' (rustfmt, clippy -D warnings, commit format) and the DCO sign-off requirement.
floss_license_justification: Apache-2.0: LICENSE at the repository root; Cargo.toml and package.json declare it.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md plus docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/INTEGRATION.md, docs/production-readiness.md, docs/SERVER.md.
documentation_interface_justification: index.d.ts (Node API), docs.rs for the Rust API, docs/SERVER.md for the HTTP interface, bindings/python/warm-sdk/README.md for the SDK.
sites_https_justification: https://github.com/writerslogic/warm, crates.io, npmjs.com, pypi.org, docs.rs and the project site are all served over HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests (https://github.com/writerslogic/warm/issues) are searchable, URL-addressable and need no proprietary client.
english_justification: Documentation, issues and commit messages are in English.
maintained_justification: Active development: hundreds of commits through October 2026 and a Scorecard 'Maintained' score of 10.
repo_track_justification: Git records author, date and diff for every change.
repo_interim_justification: Work lands as many commits and pull requests between tagged releases, not only at release time.
version_unique_justification: scripts/ci/check-versions.py fails the build unless Cargo.toml, package.json and its optionalDependencies agree on one version, and a release tag names it.
version_tags_justification: Git tags v0.6.1 and py-v0.6.1; release.yml and publish-pypi.yml are triggered by v* and py-v* tags.
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md has a section per release grouped by type, generated by git-cliff (cliff.toml) from conventional commits; docs/RELEASING.md step 5 has the maintainer write the GitHub release notes by hand before publishing the draft.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed in a release.
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Reporting Bugs' and the bug_report.yml issue form.
report_responses_justification: Few reports come from outside the maintainer; the response rate over the last 12 months has not been audited.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are tracked as issues (e.g. #40-#51) but the response rate to outside requests has not been audited.
report_archive_justification: GitHub keeps all issues and comments publicly and searchably.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled for the repository and SECURITY.md names an e-mail address.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md promises an initial response within a few days, inside the 14-day limit.
build_justification: cargo build; npm run build (napi-rs); maturin build for the wheels, all documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/RELEASING.md.
test_justification: Rust unit and integration tests (cargo test / cargo nextest), Node tests (tests/node), SDK tests against a live warm-server; run by .github/workflows/ci.yml.
test_most_justification: Line coverage of the library is 86.3% (.github/workflows/coverage.yml, .github/badges/coverage.json).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on every pull request and push to main.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Testing Policy' requires a test for new functionality.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent feature and fix pull requests (e.g. the Windows compaction fix, #112) add tests with the change.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Testing Policy' and the checklist in .github/pull_request_template.md.
warnings_justification: rustc and clippy warnings are enabled.
warnings_fixed_justification: ci.yml fails on any warning (clippy -D warnings), so none are merged.
warnings_strict_justification: `cargo clippy --all-targets [--all-features] -- -D warnings` on the newest stable clippy, plus one clippy job per feature (ci.yml).
know_secure_design_justification: docs/SECURITY.md records the threat model, trust boundaries and design choices, but the maintainer has not attested to this criterion for the form.
know_common_errors_justification: CodeQL, clippy and the fuzz targets target common error classes, but the maintainer has not attested to this criterion for the form.
crypto_published_justification: Ed25519, AES-256-GCM, Argon2 and SHA-2, via published RustCrypto implementations (docs/SECURITY.md 'Cryptographic Choices').
crypto_call_justification: Cryptography comes from the ed25519-dalek, aes-gcm, argon2 and sha2 crates; nothing is reimplemented.
crypto_floss_justification: All of those crates are FLOSS.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithm is used for security purposes (CRC32 is an integrity checksum only, not a security control).
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No MD5, SHA-1, DES or similar; docs/SECURITY.md 'Cryptographic Choices'.
crypto_password_storage_justification: WARM stores no passwords to authenticate users; passphrases only derive encryption keys with Argon2 (docs/SECURITY.md) and the server API key is compared in constant time (src/bin/warm-server.rs).
crypto_random_justification: Salts and nonces come from rand::rng(), an OS-seeded CSPRNG (src/core/security.rs).
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases are distributed through GitHub, crates.io, npm and PyPI over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No checksum or signature is fetched over an unauthenticated channel; SHA256SUMS and attestations are release assets.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Zero open Dependabot and code-scanning alerts; cargo-deny (ci.yml) fails on advisories, and the six documented ignores in deny.toml are unmaintained-crate notices or functions that are never called.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known critical vulnerability is open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled; no credentials are in the repository.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Actions) and clippy on every pull request; actionlint and zizmor on every workflow (ci.yml 'workflows').
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Code scanning shows no open alert; findings block merges through review threads.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: cargo-fuzz targets for every untrusted-input parser, run for a short time on every pull request touching fuzzed code and for longer on a schedule (.github/workflows/fuzz.yml, fuzz/); property tests (src/lib_proptest.rs).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Rust is memory safe apart from a few audited `unsafe` blocks (memory mapping); the fuzz targets run under AddressSanitizer (cargo-fuzz default).
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzz builds keep debug assertions enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Crashes found by fuzzing are fixed before the target is merged; none are open.
achieve_passing_justification: Not yet claimed: know_secure_design, know_common_errors, report_responses and enhancement_responses await the maintainer's confirmation.
dco_justification: .github/workflows/dco.yml requires Signed-off-by on commits from contributors; CONTRIBUTING.md 'Developer Certificate of Origin'.
access_continuity_justification: One maintainer; no second person holds release credentials (docs/GOVERNANCE.md 'Continuity').
bus_factor_justification: One maintainer writes nearly all commits.
documentation_roadmap_justification: No roadmap document covering the next year has been published; open enhancement issues (#40-#51) are not a roadmap.
documentation_security_justification: docs/SECURITY.md, docs/PRIVACY.md and the Security section of docs/production-readiness.md.
documentation_current_justification: Documentation changes ship with the code change in the same pull request (pull request checklist).
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows CI and Scorecard badges but not yet an OpenSSF Best Practices badge.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: A library, CLI and HTTP service with no graphical interface.
sites_password_security_justification: The project runs no site that stores passwords.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability has been reported and fixed.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md describes private reporting, the response time and coordinated disclosure.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ci.yml 'lint' runs cargo fmt --check and clippy -D warnings on every pull request.
build_standard_variables_justification: cargo honours RUSTFLAGS, CARGO_* and the CARGO_PROFILE_* variables (ci.yml and scripts/ci/repro-build.sh rely on them).
build_preserve_debug_justification: Cargo.toml's release profile strips by default, and CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP/DEBUG override it.
build_non_recursive_justification: Cargo resolves the dependency graph; there is no recursive make.
build_repeatable_justification: .github/workflows/reproducible.yml builds on two runners from different directories; warm-eval, warm-server, the napi cdylib and the crate are bit-for-bit identical, the wheel differs only in the SBOM maturin embeds (docs/RELEASING.md 'Reproducible builds').
installation_common_justification: README.md 'Installation': cargo add warm-rust, npm install writerslogic-warm, pip install holographic-vsa.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Distribution is through language package managers; there is no make install.
external_dependencies_justification: Cargo.toml and the committed Cargo.lock, package.json and package-lock.json, pyproject.toml; a CycloneDX SBOM is produced for every release artefact (release.yml).
dependency_monitoring_justification: .github/dependabot.yml (cargo, uv, pip, npm, actions), cargo-deny in ci.yml, dependency-review.yml.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies come from crates.io, npm and PyPI; none is vendored.
interfaces_current_justification: clippy -D warnings includes the deprecation lint.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: ci.yml runs tests/*.rs, the Node suites on three operating systems and the SDK against a real warm-server.
regression_tests_added50_justification: Policy requires a test with each fix (CONTRIBUTING.md) but the share of the last six months' fixes with one has not been measured.
implement_secure_design_justification: Constant-time secret comparison, zeroized keys, bounded allocations, fail-closed store opening and Argon2 key derivation (docs/SECURITY.md, src/core/security.rs, src/bin/warm-server.rs).
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: Ed25519 and AES-256-GCM are fixed; the storage format is versioned (format.json) but there is no algorithm negotiation.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: Keys come from a passphrase and the server API key from the environment (WARM_API_KEY); no credential is hard-coded.
crypto_used_network_justification: warm-server speaks plain HTTP and expects a TLS-terminating proxy (docs/SERVER.md); the SCITT client uses TLS.
crypto_tls12_justification: The only TLS use is the optional SCITT client (ureq with rustls), which supports TLS 1.2 and 1.3.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: ureq verifies certificates by default and the code does not disable it.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: TLS verification is not bypassed and no private data is sent before it.
signed_releases_justification: Past releases predate the pipeline; release.yml attests SLSA provenance and SBOMs for every artefact and attaches the bundle, but no release has shipped through it yet.
version_tags_signed_justification: The existing tags are annotated but not signed; docs/RELEASING.md requires `git tag -s` from now on.
input_validation_justification: Request, file and wire inputs are validated and size-limited (docs/production-readiness.md 'Documents and resource limits'; docs/SERVER.md); fuzz targets cover the parsers.
hardening_justification: No explicit hardening flags beyond Rust's defaults.
assurance_case_justification: No assurance case document exists; docs/SECURITY.md has the threat model only.
achieve_silver_justification: Silver is not complete (see the unmet silver criteria).
contributors_unassociated_justification: One organisation accounts for essentially all contributions.
copyright_per_file_justification: 211 Rust files all carry the notice except one (src/bin/warm-server/concurrency_tests.rs); many JavaScript, TypeScript and Python files do not.
license_per_file_justification: SPDX identifiers are in the Rust files but not in all JavaScript, TypeScript and Python files.
small_tasks_justification: Twelve open issues carry the 'good first issue' label (https://github.com/writerslogic/warm/labels/good%20first%20issue).
require_2FA_justification: The writerslogic organisation does not require two-factor authentication.
secure_2FA_justification: Not required, so not hardware-key based.
code_review_standards_justification: docs/GOVERNANCE.md 'How decisions are made' and the pull request checklist.
two_person_review_justification: The sole maintainer merges their own pull requests using the branch-protection bypass; Scorecard 'Code-Review' is 0.
hardened_site_justification: github.com serves the repository with HSTS and CSP headers; the project site's headers have not been audited against the gold list.
security_review_justification: No independent security review has been recorded.
